column1: # The frozen C++ dial path (Ruling A, 2026-10-08). Every body and calls row
# is a function the P2P-3 slice 3 cutover deletes. Until that PR, a change to
# a row's body fails `check_dial_path_freeze.py`; deleting the function
# passes, where deleted means the witness identifier (the bare name unless
# the row names one) is gone from src/ outside comments and literals. A
# definition moved out of src/p2p is still the dial path. The shrink
# rows are the C++ files the Rust lanes are replacing (Rick,
# 2026-10-09): a change may add no code lines to them. Deletions are free;
# comment-only additions are free; an edited line, or logic swapped for a
# call into Rust, is an added code line. This file is the list the dialer
# The one exception is a line in the dialer brief, new in the PR, of exactly
# this form, naming the row's full anchor or the shrink row's file path:
# A line naming a function covers that row and nothing else; editing a frozen
# function inside a shrink file takes a second line naming the file. The
# cutover removes the body and calls rows; the gate then reports the function
# freeze discharged. A shrink row is retired only when its file is deleted,
# not renamed or split: net_node.inl outlives the dial path.
#   kind    body   the function from its anchor to its closing brace
#           calls  the lines inside that function that call the fourth column
#           shrink the file takes deletions only
#   anchor  the definition's qualified name up to its opening parenthesis;
#           it must occur once in the file (body and calls rows)
#   fourth  calls rows: the function those frozen lines call
#           body rows, optional: a witness identifier for the gone check,
#           for a function whose bare name is an ordinary word
